content.tagline: Korean skincare brand inspired by Korean tradition
content.descriptor: OAVO: Korean skincare with the KOREA Silktree botanical (Stewartia koreana), a brand space in Seoul and Korean beauty education
about: OAVO is a Korean beauty brand represented by Channel Swan Co., Ltd. According to its official website, the brand takes its inspiration from Irwol-obongdo, the traditional Korean painting of the sun, moon, five peaks and waves, and brings Korean aesthetics into contemporary products and spaces.

The collection presented on the website includes a Peel-off Mask, a Serum and a Sun Serum. KOREA Silktree is the name OAVO uses for its Stewartia koreana botanical story; the company states that the Peel-off Mask ingredient list includes Stewartia Koreana Leaf Extract.

Beyond products, the brand runs OAVO Seoul Lounge in Hongdae, Seoul, and OAVO K Style Lab & Academy for personal colour, style and education. According to the website, OAVO grew out of its founder’s experience in corporate promotions, exhibitions and brand experiences. This description is the company’s own; Teranova has not verified it independently.
